unique_axis.description: two-fold axis of a monoclinic crystal

unit.description: unit of the stiffness values written as bare numbers, for example "GPa"

conductivity.description: electrical conductivity, S/m. One value (isotropic), 3 (x y z), 6 (xx yy zz yz xz xy), a symmetric 3x3 array, or { perp, par } (unique axis along crystal z)

permittivity.description: relative permittivity at low frequency. One value (isotropic), 3 (x y z), 6 (xx yy zz yz xz xy), a symmetric 3x3 array, or { perp, par } (unique axis along crystal z)

optical.description: wavelength-dependent index; time convention e^{j omega t}, complex index n - j k. Put the model keys here (isotropic) or in per-axis tables

A.description: sellmeier: n^2 = A + sum B x^2/(x^2 - C), default 1

C.description: sellmeier: squared resonance wavelengths in wavelength_unit^2

data.description: tabulated: rows [wavelength, n] or [wavelength, n, k], wavelength increasing

oneOf.description: a number with its unit, for example "496.8 GPa"
a bare number: needs the unit declared in a sibling key `<name>_unit` (or `unit` in [elastic]), unless dimensionless

eps.description: constant model: relative permittivity (alternative to n)

extraordinary.description: model along this crystal axis (ordinary/extraordinary: uniaxial about z; x/y/z: biaxial)

k.description: constant model: extinction coefficient; the complex index is n - j k

lambda0.description: sellmeier: resonance wavelengths in wavelength_unit (instead of C)

ordinary.description: model along this crystal axis (ordinary/extraordinary: uniaxial about z; x/y/z: biaxial)

range.description: validity range [min, max] in wavelength_unit; required for formula models; a wavelength outside it is an error

reference_temperature.description: temperature the models hold at, default 293.15 K; with dn_dT the index shifts by dn_dT (T - reference)

wavelength_unit.description: unit of every wavelength, range and coefficient of this section, for example "um"; required unless all models are constant

x.description: model along this crystal axis (ordinary/extraordinary: uniaxial about z; x/y/z: biaxial)

y.description: model along this crystal axis (ordinary/extraordinary: uniaxial about z; x/y/z: biaxial)

z.description: model along this crystal axis (ordinary/extraordinary: uniaxial about z; x/y/z: biaxial)

conductivity.description: thermal conductivity, W/(m K). One value (isotropic), 3 (x y z), 6 (xx yy zz yz xz xy), a symmetric 3x3 array, or { perp, par } (unique axis along crystal z)

expansion.description: thermal expansion, 1/K. One value (isotropic), 3 (x y z), 6 (xx yy zz yz xz xy), a symmetric 3x3 array, or { perp, par } (unique axis along crystal z)

oneOf.description: a number with its unit, for example "496.8 GPa"
a bare number: needs the unit declared in a sibling key `<name>_unit` (or `unit` in [elastic]), unless dimensionless
